description: This Dart test source file verifies the current working directory during CI runs to ensure it is correctly positioned at the Flutter project root by checking for the presence of specific marker files and directories such as pubspec.yaml, lib/main.dart, and android/. It outputs diagnostic messages and fails the test if the expected structure is not found.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The entry point of the test which performs the directory checks and prints diagnostic information.
